text:
jordan: Quick scheduling — can we lock ARB (Architecture Review Board) for Tue 10:00am PT starting next week? I want to land a rotating facilitator cadence and a lightweight agenda template. I'll create the calendar invite if folks are good. Draft agenda: 1) RFC reviews (RFC-412), 2) platform-standards housekeeping, 3) triage quick wins. Please +1 or suggest changes by EOD Fri. @maria @devon

maria: Works for me in general. Heads-up: 10:00am PT hits late afternoon for EMEA — can we consider 10:30am once a month to help rotate times for cross-region folks?

devon: 10:00 PT is ok on my side. I support rotating facilitators. I can take the first slot (Oct 6) if that helps.

calendar-bot: :calendar: Event created — "Architecture Review Board" Tue Oct 6 10:00am PT. Link: https://cal.redwood.com/event/abc123 (description: draft agenda + prereads)

sam: I'm OOO Oct 6, FYI. If devon is facilitating then cool. Please add "model quantization guidance" to agenda — short 10min slot.

nina: +1 on prereads. Posting RFC-412 here for quick review: https://rbw.in/rfc/412. Folks, please leave comments inline before the meeting.

alex: Suggest we keep a 4-week facilitator rotation: devon -> maria -> alex -> jordan, repeat. I can facilitate Nov 3.

jordan: Updated proposal for rotation: devon (10/6), maria (10/13), alex (10/20), jordan (10/27). Who wants 11/3? @pradeep?

pradeep: Happy to take 11/3. Also propose reserving 10 minutes for "standards housekeeping" each meeting (quick infra/policy sync).

maria: One ask — EOD Fri for agenda items is a bit tight for some teams. Can we extend the cut-off to Mon 09:00 PT so engineers have time after sprint close?

jordan: Fine with extending. New cutoff: Mon 09:00 PT. I'll publish final agenda Mon 10:00 PT and update calendar description.

devon: Adding two quick items to the agenda draft: (1) rollout policy for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, (2) default KV-cache config recommendation for large-model workloads.

alex: Noted. I'll drop links to the two design docs into the calendar event so prereads are easy to find.

calendar-bot: Event updated with doc links and agenda slots.

jordan: Thanks all. Final notes: facilitators should prepare a 2-3 slide summary and a 5-min kickoff. If you need to swap weeks, please arrange early and post the swap here. See you Tue (or add items before Mon 09:00 PT). :thumbsup:
